chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abu Al-Hasan Al-Reza (peace be upon him), that he was asked about the Mutamatti', when does he cut off the Talbiyya?
He (peace be upon him) said: 'When he looks at the chairs (tents/structures) of Makkah at the end of Thi Tuwwa.' I said, 'Houses of Makkah?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Yes'.

key_terms.عَقَبَةَ ذِي طُوًى: Aqabat Thi Tuwwa (the end/pass of Thi Tuwwa)

ai.seo_question: When should a pilgrim stop reciting Talbiyya during Hajj al-Tamattu'?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Rida (AS) provides the precise jurisprudential marker for terminating the state of Ihram for a Mutamatti', linking the cessation of Talbiyya to the visual sighting of Makkah's structures at Uqba Thi Tuwwa. This ruling underscores the significance of physical presence and visual confirmation in Shia fiqh, distinguishing the boundary between the pilgrimage rites and the preceding state of consecration. It reflects the scholarly emphasis on clear, observable criteria to ensure the validity of ritual transitions during Hajj.
